name: Zhejiang Communications Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Communications Technology Co., Ltd. operates in the infrastructure engineering business in China and internationally. It is involved in the investment, design, construction, maintenance, and engineering project consulting and management of transportation infrastructure, such as roads, bridges, tunnels, rail transit, ports and docks, underground projects, etc. The company also engages in municipal projects, such as housing construction and municipal administration, waterproofing, and road lighting engineering; and thermal insulation, steel structures, traffic safety, testing and inspection, and environmental protection engineering.
